_rules: Proof-shelf rule (CLAUDE.md): a quote renders ONLY when permission is true, meaning the client's written sign-off is on file. Surfaces, all from this one file via scripts/build-testimonials.mjs: full 'In their words' section on / and /work/; one B:Side-attributed featured quote on /work/marcus/results/; a one-line version in the /book/ rail (field `short`, a client-approved cut covered by the same sign-off). Zero permissioned quotes = none of these render — no placeholders. Removing permission: true removes the quote everywhere on the next rebuild. Never hand-edit the rendered sections. Fields: quote, name, role, company, permission (boolean), date (YYYY-MM-DD, sign-off received), featured (boolean, optional), short (string, optional).
